question:
**In the following question, out of the given four alternatives, select the alternative which best expresses the meaning of the Idiom/Phrase.**

To stretch one's legs

options.text: To leave a place without permission
To go for a walk after you have been sitting for a long time

solution:
The correct answer is: **To go for a walk after you have been sitting for a long time.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom "**to stretch one's legs**" means to take a walk or move around after sitting or being still for a long time. (लंबे समय तक बैठने या स्थिर रहने के बाद टहलना या घूमना)

 
 
• **For example-** *I needed to stretch my legs after spending all day sitting around in meetings.*
 
 
 
• This phrase is often used when travelling on long journeys, such as on a plane or in a car.
 
• It is important to stretch one's legs to improve circulation and prevent stiffness or cramps.
 
• This idiom can also be used figuratively to mean taking a break or getting some fresh air to clear one's mind.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Let us look at the other options.

 
• Option 1: **To leave a place without permission** - This is not related to the meaning of the idiom.
 
• Option 2: **To go for a party** - This is not related to the meaning of the idiom.
 
• Option 4: **To measure one's worth** - This is not related to the meaning of the idiom.
